models_evaluated: generative AI-based CAD system (latent diffusion synthetic image augmentation)

links.outcome: Endoscopist adenoma sensitivity with versus without CAD assistance in reader study
links.effect: CAD assistance raised adenoma sensitivity from 63.47% to 70.56% (p < 0.01), with improved predictive values; both expert and trainee endoscopists benefited and interobserver variability decreased.
links.quote: In the reader study, CAD assistance significantly increased adenoma sensitivity (63.47%-70.56%; p < 0.01), with corresponding improvements in predictive values.

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing endoscopists' diagnostic performance with versus without CAD assistance.
